text:
sachin: Quick sync — proposing a staggered deprecation plan for API v2 -> v3 compatibility. Need owners for: auth, routing, SDK, telemetry, docs. Plan: 4-week slice rollout per surface, canary traffic 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 48h, rollback policy + fallback to v2 shim. Checklist below:

- owners assigned
- canary metrics + alerts
- SDK runtime flag + deprecation banner
- routing header toggle + console pin
- migration guide + sample repo

maria: I can own SDK. Will prepare a minor v2-compatible release (2.9.x) that warns on startup and adds a `compat_mode` flag.

leo: I'll take routing (edge). We'll use a short-lived header `x-rw-compat` to opt into shim routing. Question: stable header name or ephemeral?

darren: Telemetry: I'll add metrics `compat.migration.success` and `compat.rollback.count`. Will bind alerts to >3% error delta vs baseline.

claire: Docs: I can draft the migration guide + FAQ. ETA EOD Wed. Will also create a small sample repo for migration snippets.

sachin: Owners confirmed: SDK=maria, Routing=leo, Telemetry=darren, Docs=claire. Can we confirm windows? Proposal: Week1 canary 1% / Week2 5% / Week3 20% / Week4 full (with opt-out for high-traffic partners). Thoughts?

leo: Works for routing. One ask: add a console toggle so customers can pin traffic to v2 for up to 30 days. Who owns console toggles? Product/console team?

maria: SDK will emit a deprecation banner: `DEPRECATION: v2 endpoints will be removed on <cut-date>`. We'll add `compat_mode` env var that disables the banner and keeps v2 behavior. Need a firm cut date to populate message.

darren: @sachin ops would prefer 30-day notice before banners go live. Can we pick a tentative cut date now?

sachin: Tentative cut date: 2025-09-30. I'll confirm by EOD Friday and publish the rollout ticket.

oncall-bot: deploybot: Canary release started for slice=alpha at 2025-03-18T15:02Z — routing 1% traffic to `v3-shim`. Monitor metric `canary.fail`.

claire: Note for docs: include curl example and SDK snippet. I'll add this curl example to the guide:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "x-rw-compat: v3" https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate
```

maria: SDK snippet we'll include:
```
client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
client.set_option('compat_mode', True)  # keeps v2 behavior and suppresses banner
```

darren: :eyes: I'll provision a dashboard template for the canary slice and hook the new metrics. Ping me for access if you want a quick dashboard.

sachin: Next steps: maria/leo/darren/claire to post PRs for their lanes by Thu EOD. I'll create the GH rollout ticket with timeline, owners, and rollback playbook. If no objections by EOD we'll lock schedule and start slice ops.

leo: One more: add automated CI acceptance tests that assert header routing and shim fallback. I'll open a test PR.

maria: ACK — will add SDK unit tests for deprecation log and compat flag.

sachin: Thanks everyone — logging this thread into the rollout ticket now. :thumbsup:
